description: This file defines the networking API for authentication actions such as login, refresh, logout, and fetching user info in a Swift-based iOS application. It includes data models, API calls, and error handling specific to the authentication process.

classes.name: AuthAPI
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for managing authentication-related network requests, including login, token refresh, logout, and retrieving user info.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Sends login credentials to the backend and receives a token pair in response.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens using a refresh token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by invalidating the refresh token on the backend.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Fetches current user information from the backend.

methods.name: mapTokenResponseToTokenPair
methods.description: Converts TokenResponse data into a TokenPair with an absolute expiration timestamp.

methods.name: requireHTTP
methods.description: Ensures the URLResponse is an HTTPURLResponse.
